title: A flow's result follows the user across steps - floating window off the last step

summary: Claimed. Root cause already named in brief; building the floating result dock.

BOTH HALVES BUILT, automated checks green, awaiting Fabio (verify: user-ux). New Compound MpiFlowResultDock (stage top-right) + MpiBaseFlow `_sharedAudioEl`/`_dockNode`/`_syncDock`; openFlowFromReuse now seeds s_flowResults so a reused card opens holding its result. ONLY AUDIO IS MOVED - the spec mutes and loops video and thumbnails images, so a fresh element is indistinguishable there; audio is the one kind where it is audibly the bug, so MpiVideoViewer and the compare canvas were left untouched. 933/933 node tests, 15/15 desktop flow specs, eslint + lint:components clean. The real proof is tests/desktop/flow-result-follows-steps.spec.js: it stamps the <audio> node, plays a real tone, walks two navigations and asserts the SAME node is still playing - MUTATION-PROVEN (re-creating the element in _paintPlainResults turns it red). Scope grew mid-build via mpi-message 8b3c6f19; folded into brief.md by this session.
